Onagraceae.key_tie_breaker: Inferior ovary below a hypanthium/floral tube + usually 4-part flower + commonly 4-lobed stigma. Then split classic primrose capsules from former-Gaura hard indehiscent fruits.
teaching_cautions: Do not teach Onagraceae by flower color.
Do not treat radial symmetry or 8 stamens as absolutes.
Do not call every local fruit a dehiscent capsule; sect. Gaura often has hard indehiscent few-seeded capsules.
Oenothera lindheimeri retains its existing user-approved range exception.

Anacardiaceae.taxonomy_note: Source-row count includes synonym/duplicate concepts: Rhus trilobata folds into Rhus aromatica var. aromatica; Toxicodendron rydbergii maps to Toxicodendron radicans subsp. rydbergii.
Anacardiaceae.key_tie_breaker: Woody + alternate exstipulate leaves + resinous tissues + small usually 5-merous flowers + superior ovary + drupe. For local genus split: Rhus usually red hairy terminal drupes; Toxicodendron pale axillary drupes, with aerial rootlets in climbing T. radicans.
teaching_cautions: Do not teach 'leaves of three = poison ivy'; Rhus aromatica also has three leaflets.
Do not use sap contact or crushing as an identification test.
Do not double-count Rhus trilobata as a separate current species under the present POWO/FNA treatment.
Keep Toxicodendron radicans subsp. rydbergii pending dedicated local/range review.
